collection-mobile/evidence.json.scope: Read-only real summary clicks; no cart/order/checkout interaction

h2: Darauf kommt es bei der Auswahl an

cases.firstParagraph: Die X3 ist eine schwarze, kabelgebundene USB-Gaming-Maus mit farbwechselnder Beleuchtung. Die Produktbeschreibung nennt vier DPI-Stufen im Bereich von 1000 bis 5500 und ein 145 cm langes Kabel mit Nylon-Geflecht.

Die AK-600 ist eine kabelgebundene USB-Gaming-Tastatur mit 104 Tasten und dreifarbiger Beleuchtung. Das gelieferte Sprachlayout ist nicht eindeutig bestätigt: Die Produktdaten nennen eine «Russian Version», während auf den Produktbildern lateinische Tastenbeschriftungen zu sehen sind. Ein deutsches oder Schweizer QWERTZ-Layout ist nicht bestätigt.

pc-mobile/review-assessment.json.scope: Local-only review of pc-mobile/evidence.json, four captured screenshots, pc-final-copy-plans.json, and public-after-verification.json. No network queries or writes to Shopify.

mouse.reason: The screenshot visibly shows 'Ausführung Schwarz, Tyrannosaurus Rex'. The native/current page has one variant, so the theme displays its value as static text and hides variant-picker/.lx-bildwahl controls. The `specific` check in evidence.json expected a visible selector; its false result is a test assumption mismatch, not a reason to add a picker.
mouse.contentBoundary: The mouse title/meta avoid a six-button claim. Body explicitly explains that source values differ (six in product description vs seven in another product name), and avoids a programming claim. DPI values are given as a 1000–5500 range in four stages; no intermediate values are invented. Product dimensions are 130 × 85 × 40 mm.

keyboard.contentBoundary: The heading and first paragraph foreground unresolved Russian Version vs Latin-looking legends. No German/Swiss QWERTZ or selectable layout is asserted. Product dimensions remain 442 × 133 × 30 mm from product descriptions; the logistics dimensions are excluded.

pc-mobile/review-assessment.json.publicVerification: Both product entries in public-after-verification.json have allChecks=true: HTTP 200, title/meta, H1, self-canonical, no noindex, body links, public JSON/IDs and variant details. Other collection/product entries were read for context only; this review does not add new checks for them.
pc-mobile/review-assessment.json.result: PASS within the narrow local review scope; the mouse evidence bundle's aggregate allPassed=false is caused only by the inapplicable visible-picker heuristic. Original evidence was left unchanged.

mobileLimits: Screenshots and real variant clicks are a targeted browser QA, not full-catalog/cross-device certification. Headphone mobile captures predate final minor qualifier/alt refinements; final public/native evidence verifies those fields. Mouse original selector heuristic is preserved and independently explained as not applicable for its single variant.
